function.name: impl_from_IWICColorContext
function.description: This function returns the containing record of the given interface in the ColorContext structure.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICColorContext interface

function.return_type: ColorContext *; Pointer to the ColorContext structure that contains the given interface

function.name: ColorContext_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query an interface of a color context. If the requested interface is supported, it returns a pointer to that interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICColorContext interface

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of a pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in iid. Upon successful return, *ppv contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppv is set to NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. If the function is successful, it returns S_OK. If the function fails, it returns an error code. For example, if the ppv parameter is NULL, it returns E_INVALIDARG. If the requested interface is not supported, it returns E_NOINTERFACE.

function.name: ColorContext_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of a ColorContext object and returns the new reference count.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IWICColorContext interface of the ColorContext object whose reference count is to be incremented.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the ColorContext object.

function.name: ColorContext_Release
function.description: This function decrements the reference count of the ColorContext object. If the reference count becomes zero, it frees the memory allocated for the profile and the object itself.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the IWICColorContext interface of the ColorContext object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the ColorContext object after decrementing.

function.name: load_profile
function.description: This function reads a file into a byte array and returns the length of the array. It handles file opening, reading, and error checking.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The name of the file to be read

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: A pointer to a byte array where the file content will be stored

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: A pointer to an unsigned integer where the length of the byte array will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_FAIL if the file is too large or if the read count doesn't match the file size, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, or a system error code if any other operation fails

function.name: ColorContext_InitializeFromFilename
function.description: This function initializes a color context from a given filename. It loads the profile, frees any existing profile, and sets the new profile and its length. It also sets the type to WICColorContextProfile.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICColorContext interface which is used to retrieve the color context implementation.

parameters.name: wzFilename
parameters.description: Pointer to a wide-character string that specifies the filename from which the color context is to be initialized.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the color context is not in the uninitialized or profile state, it returns WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE. If the filename is null, it returns E_INVALIDARG. If the profile loading fails, it returns the error code from the failed operation.

function.name: ColorContext_InitializeFromMemory
function.description: This function initializes a color context from a memory buffer. It checks the current state of the color context, allocates memory for the new profile, copies the profile from the buffer to the newly allocated memory, frees the old profile, and updates the color context with the new profile.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICColorContext interface

parameters.name: pbBuffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer that contains the color profile

parameters.name: cbBufferSize
parameters.description: Size of the buffer that contains the color profile

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, and WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the color context is in an incorrect state.

function.name: ColorContext_InitializeFromExifColorSpace
function.description: This function initializes a color context from an Exif color space. If the color context is not uninitialized or not an Exif color space, it returns an error. Otherwise, it sets the Exif color space and type of the color context and returns a success code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: A pointer to an IWICColorContext interface that represents the color context to be initialized.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: An unsigned integer that represents the Exif color space value to be set.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents a success or error code. It returns S_OK for success, and WINCODEC_ERR_WRONGSTATE if the color context is not uninitialized or not an Exif color space.

function.name: ColorContext_GetType
function.description: This function retrieves the type of a color context.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICColorContext interface

parameters.name: pType
parameters.description: Pointer to a WICColorContextType variable to receive the color context type

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error value otherwise

function.name: ColorContext_GetProfileBytes
function.description: This function retrieves the color profile bytes from a ColorContext object. It checks if the color context is initialized and if the buffer is large enough to hold the profile. If so, it copies the profile into the buffer and sets the actual size of the profile.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the ColorContext interface

parameters.name: cbBuffer
parameters.description: Size of the buffer to hold the profile

parameters.name: pbBuffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer to hold the profile

parameters.name: pcbActual
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the actual size of the profile

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED if the color context is not initialized, and E_INVALIDARG if the pcbActual pointer is NULL.

function.name: ColorContext_GetExifColorSpace
function.description: This function retrieves the Exif color space from a color context.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICColorContext interface that represents the color context.

parameters.name: pValue
parameters.description: Pointer to a UINT value that receives the Exif color space.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error value otherwise.

function.name: ColorContext_Create
function.description: This function creates a new ColorContext object, initializes its properties and assigns it to the provided pointer.

parameters.name: colorcontext
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a IWICColorContext object. This function will assign a new ColorContext object to this pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the provided argument is invalid, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if there is not enough memory to create the new object.
